title: Defect record (registry/defects/SL-DEF-NNNN.yaml)
description: The root cause of a bug at component level: where it came from, its forms, triggers, detectors, fixes, effects and a regression bench pinned by commit. Every cited commit is a {component, commit} pair so T0 can prove it exists on the canonical host. Owner: registry loader. F1, F2, F3, F6, F7.

component.description: F1: the component where the root cause lives now.

origin.description: F1: the commits that introduced it. Can span components.

forms.description: F1: the shapes the defect takes. A fix can cover some forms and not others.

fixed_in.description: F1 fixes; F6 (Phase 3) fills this from `Fixes:` and `Defect:` trailers. Empty = unfixed.

candidate_fix.description: A proposed fix not yet on the default branch.

trigger.description: F1: the SoC conditions that make it reachable.

detectors.description: F1, F2: checks that prove exposure on a configuration's built output. Empty = none exists yet, so exposure can only be `probably-exposed`.

command.description: Run on the built output. `{dir}` is replaced by the output directory.

pattern.description: Extended regex that matches the defect in the output.

source.description: Where a command detector's code lives, pinned by commit (F3). A pattern detector lives in this record.

effects.description: F1: what goes wrong, per form, so a partial fix shows which effects remain.

regression_test.description: F1: the bench that reproduces it, pinned by commit, never by branch. null = no bench yet (shown, never hidden).

expect.description: Expected bench result per build: `defect` (reproduces) or `clean`.

issues.description: F7: the repo issues labelled `defect` this record was promoted from.
